# statuspage_subscriber (Data Source)

Fetches a Statuspage subscriber.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspage_subscriber" "example" {
  page_id = "abc123def456"
  id      = "xyz789"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `component_ids` (List of String)
- `email` (String)
- `endpoint` (String) Webhook endpoint URL.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mode` (String)
- `phone_country` (String)
- `phone_number` (String)
